text: Check Your Voter RegistrationConfirm you are registered and that your address, precinct, and party are current before Election Day. The process takes less than a minute.Check my status
Find Your Polling LocationSee your assigned polling place and its hours for Election Day, or locate an early voting center near you.Find where to vote
Join the Active Early Voting List (AEVL)Automatically receive a ballot by mail for every election — formerly the Permanent Early Voting List (PEVL).Join the AEVL
